learning_outcomes.text: Create 3D models of parts and assemblies.
Prepare mechanical drawings of parts and assemblies.

syllabus_topics: The basic philosophy of 3D modeling. Creation of basic types of models. Creating volumes extrude, rotation.
The cutting of the volumes, creating holes, thin models, ribs. Fillet and chamfer.
Creation of auxiliary elements. Datum planes, axis, points coordinate systems.
Other types of models, extrude more sketches, extrude of sketches along the curve.
Creation of auxiliary elements. The area axis, the point coordinate system.
Preparation of a model for creating a assembly, the types of conections. Redefining the location of components in the assembly.
Modification in the assembly, changing of parts dimensions, and moving and rotation part of the. Creating components in the assembly.
Copy components. Relationships in the assembly. Making sections in the assembly. Modification of sections in the assembly.
Advanced techniques of model making. Creating models of springs, sketching curves.
Define relationships in the model, the tool "Family table.
Creation of drawings of parts and assemblies.
